findings.body: The line `pub mod summarise;` declares a module that requires a corresponding file `src/findings/summarise.rs` (or `src/findings/summarise/mod.rs`). The repository context did not contain this file at the reviewed commit, so the build would fail with a missing module error. The author should add the file or remove the declaration.
findings.title: Create the declared module file

value.summary: The change adds a `pub mod summarise;` declaration but does not provide the corresponding file `src/findings/summarise.rs`, which would break the build. The author should ensure the module file exists before merging.
